title: Product Overview and Brand Heritage
text:
## Product Overview and Brand Heritage
The Citizen CX-02 photo printer is engineered by Citizen Systems Japan and distributed in the UAE by Kepler Tech LLC. It delivers continuous-tone, laboratory-quality photo prints in a compact, portable chassis. Known for commercial reliability, the CX-02 is widely deployed for event photography, photo booths, entertainment venues, portrait studios, and instant retail photo printing.

title: Applications and Ideal Use Cases
text:
## Applications and Ideal Use Cases
The Citizen CX-02 is designed for high-demand photo environments:
- Photo Booths: Ultra-compact dimensions (170 mm height, 275 mm width) fit easily into slim photo booth enclosures, retro wooden booths, and mirror booths.
- Event and Wedding Photography: High-speed 8.4-second printing ensures fast turnover for guest souvenirs.
- Retail Kiosks: Front-loading media mechanism allows quick consumable changes in seconds.
- ID and Portrait Photos: 300 x 600 DPI resolution produces crisp biometric details and smooth skin tones.

title: Advantages Over Inkjet Printing
text:
## Advantages Over Inkjet Printing
- Instantly Dry and Protected: Prints exit completely dry and laminated with a clear protective overcoat layer that resists water, UV light, and fingerprints.
- No Clogging: Thermal dye-sublimation ribbons eliminate wet ink nozzles and drying issues.
- Multiple Finishes from One Roll: Switch between glossy, matte, and fine matte finishes digitally via driver settings without changing media.
- Sleep Mode Energy Savings: Lowers standby power consumption under 0.5W.

title: Print Engine and Technology
text:
## Print Engine and Technology
- Printing Technology: Dye-sublimation thermal transfer with ribbon rewind technology
- Resolution Modes: 300 x 300 DPI (High Speed Mode) and 300 x 600 DPI (High Resolution Mode)
- Gradation: 256 levels per colour (8-bit per colour channel, total 16.7 million colours)
- Colour Ribbons: Yellow, Magenta, Cyan plus transparent protective overcoat
- Buffer Memory: 64 MB internal high-speed image buffer

title: Ribbon Rewind and Ribbon-Save Feature
text:
## Ribbon Rewind and Ribbon-Save Feature
The Citizen CX-02 features an intelligent ribbon rewind function:
- Ribbon-Save Mechanism: When printing odd numbers of 4x6" photos on 6x8" media or half-format sizes, the printer rewinds unused ribbon sections.
- Cost Efficiency: Prevents wasted ribbon ink panels and maximizes total print yields per media roll.
- Zero Waste: Eliminates the need to print pairs of photos when only one is needed.

title: Print Sizes and Capacity
text:
## Print Sizes and Capacity
- 4 x 6 inches (102 x 152 mm): 400 prints per roll, 800 prints per 2-roll media box (SKU: CX2-MS46-2PC, estimated 800 prints per set)
- 5 x 7 inches (127 x 178 mm): 230 prints per roll, 460 prints per 2-roll media box (SKU: CX2-MS57-2PC, verified 460 prints per set)
- 6 x 8 inches (152 x 203 mm): 200 prints per roll, 400 prints per 2-roll media box (SKU: CX2-MS68-2PC, estimated 400 prints per set)
- 6 x 9 inches (152 x 229 mm): 180 prints per roll (hardware supported; 6x9 media sets not stocked by Kepler Tech LLC)
- 2 x 6 inches (51 x 152 mm): Photo booth strips enabled through driver dual cut feature on 4x6" or 6x8" media

title: Print Speeds
text:
## Print Speeds
- 4 x 6 inch: 8.4 seconds (High Speed mode) / 9.8 seconds (High Quality mode)
- 5 x 7 inch: 14.2 seconds
- 6 x 8 inch: 15.6 seconds
- 6 x 9 inch: 20.8 seconds

title: Finishes and Surface Control
text:
## Finishes and Surface Control
- Finishes: Glossy, Matte, and Fine Matte (Luster) finishes available.
- Digital Control: Finishes are selected directly within the printer driver software using the thermal head temperature profile on the clear protective overcoat layer. No special paper or ribbon changes are required.
- Protective Lamination: Automatically applied as a 4th pass layer, providing water resistance, UV protection, and fingerprint resistance.

title: Paper and Ribbon Loading
text:
## Paper and Ribbon Loading
- Front-loading drop-in paper roll and ribbon cassette mechanism.
- Fast reloading: Designed for quick consumable replacement in under 60 seconds, even in compact photo booth enclosures or dark event environments.
- Removable scrap bin: Catches paper trims and edge cuts to maintain a clean workspace.

title: Physical Dimensions and Weight
text:
## Physical Dimensions and Weight
- Width: 275 mm (10.8 inches)
- Depth: 366 mm (14.4 inches)
- Height: 170 mm (6.7 inches)
- Net Weight: 12.0 kg (26.5 lbs) excluding media and ribbon
- Gross Packaged Weight: 13.5 kg (29.8 lbs)
- Compact Form Factor: 33% smaller in volume and 14% lighter than preceding models such as the CX-01.

title: Connectivity and Operating Systems
text:
## Connectivity and Operating Systems
- Interface: High-speed USB 2.0 (Type-B connector)
- Supported Operating Systems: Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, Windows 11 (32-bit and 64-bit); macOS 10.12 Sierra up to macOS 14 Sonoma; Linux CUPS drivers available.
- Power Supply: AC 100V - 240V, 50/60 Hz internal auto-switching power supply.
- Power Consumption: Standby power under 0.5W in Sleep Mode (Energy Star compliant).

title: Official Accessories and Consumables Overview
text:
## Official Accessories and Consumables Overview
- Citizen CX-02 Protective Carry Bag (SKU: CX-02-BAG): Custom padded ballistic nylon carrying case with heavy-duty handles, detachable shoulder strap, and storage compartments for USB and power cables. Protects the printer during event transit.
- Citizen Thermal Head Cleaning Pen (SKU: CITIZEN-PEN): Specially formulated non-abrasive thermal printhead cleaning pen to clear dust, fibers, and residue, preserving head lifespan and preventing print streaks.
- 4x6" Media Set (SKU: CX2-MS46-2PC): Contains 2 rolls of paper and 2 ribbon rolls, delivering an estimated 800 prints per box (400 prints per roll).
- 5x7" Media Set (SKU: CX2-MS57-2PC): Contains 2 rolls of paper and 2 ribbon rolls, delivering a verified 460 prints per box (230 prints per roll).
- 6x8" Media Set (SKU: CX2-MS68-2PC): Contains 2 rolls of paper and 2 ribbon rolls, delivering an estimated 400 prints per box (200 prints per roll).
